title: FilterDirect Stocked Size Schedule and Custom-Size Surcharge
content:
Each grade of FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions has its own list of nominal sizes stocked without surcharge, written width by height by depth in inches. A filter in a size that is not on its grade's list carries a custom-size surcharge for each such filter.

| Grade | Nominal sizes stocked without surcharge | Custom-size surcharge, per filter |
|---|---|---|
| FilterDirect Standard MERV 8 | 14x20x1, 14x25x1, 16x20x1, 16x25x1, 20x20x1, 20x25x1, 20x30x1 | $6.00 |
| FilterDirect Pleated MERV 11 | 14x20x1, 14x25x1, 16x20x1, 16x25x1, 20x20x1, 20x25x1, 20x30x1 | $6.00 |
| FilterDirect Allergen MERV 13 | 14x20x1, 14x25x1, 16x20x1, 16x25x1, 20x20x1, 20x25x1, 20x30x1 | $8.00 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 11 | 16x25x4, 20x20x4, 20x25x4 | $10.00 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 13 | 16x25x4, 20x20x4, 20x25x4 | $12.00 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 16 | 16x25x5, 20x25x5 | $15.00 |

### Points of judgement

- **Stocked or custom.** A size is stocked for a grade only when it appears on that grade's own list in the table above. The 1-inch grades share one list of seven sizes; Media Cabinet MERV 11 and Media Cabinet MERV 13 share one list of three sizes; Media Cabinet MERV 16 has a list of two sizes.
- **Counted per filter.** The surcharge is not a flat amount per shipment: it is the grade's surcharge figure taken once for every filter of a non-stocked size.
- **Same size, different grade.** The surcharge figure belongs to the grade, so one non-stocked size carries a different surcharge under different grades.

### Hypothetical illustrations

| Hypothetical case | Size on that grade's list? | Surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| A filter of 16x25x1 under FilterDirect Pleated MERV 11 | Yes | None |
| A filter of a hypothetical 18x24x1 size under FilterDirect Standard MERV 8 | No | $6.00 for that filter |
| Two filters of the same hypothetical 18x24x1 size under FilterDirect Allergen MERV 13 | No | $8.00 for each filter, $16.00 for the two |
| A filter of 20x25x5 under FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 16 | Yes | None |
